panels.scene_en: a huge dark castle library with tall bookshelves and cobwebs
Klarka shines her flashlight at the wall between the books, the owl sits on her shoulder with his head turned all the way round

bubbles.speaker: klarka
bubbles.text: Hugo, osvětli tu horní polici. Určitě tu musí být tajné tlačítko.

panels.scene_en: the owl flaps up to a family coat of arms on the wall and pecks at the stone lion on it
the bookshelf swings open revealing a secret stone passage glowing with blue light

bubbles.text: Za knihovnou se otevře tajná chodba.

panels.scene_en: a glowing translucent ghost knight emerges from the stone wall, Klarka jumps back in surprise while the owl calmly lands on the knight's helmet
the friendly ghost knight floats and scratches his helmet, the owl sitting on top

bubbles.speaker: jaromir
bubbles.text: Ahoj malá průzkumnice! Neviděla jsi tady někde moje klíče od komnaty?

panels.scene_en: Klarka smiles and points at an old grandfather clock

bubbles.speaker: klarka
bubbles.text: Nebyly náhodou zavěšené na kyvadle těch starých hodin?

panels.scene_en: close-up of a glowing old iron key hanging on the swinging pendulum of a grandfather clock
